findings.evidence: The only direct use in lines 46–65 is `(hmap _)` at line 65; lines 173 and 199 use only `hmap i`, while the remaining local results merely pass `hmap` to those helpers. `SidePairing.map_pair` at `SidePairing/Basic.lean:100` states `map (pair i) = (map i)⁻¹`, and subgroup membership is closed under inversion.
findings.fix: Give `eq_one_or_eq_map_pair_of_smul_mem_side` the hypothesis `σ.map (σ.pair i) ∈ Γ`, and give the other pointwise theorems `σ.map i ∈ Γ`, deriving paired-map membership from `σ.map_pair`; retain the global hypothesis only in the exhaustive theorem at line 236.
findings.issue: The local theorems at lines 46, 81, 165, 184, 202, and 215 all assume `hmap : ∀ i, σ.map i ∈ Γ`; their proofs use membership only for the selected side (or its paired side), so callers cannot use them when only the relevant pairing is known to lie in Γ.

summary: The local side-point API unnecessarily requires every side-pairing map to belong to Γ, although only the indexed side map is needed.
